title: Tevil
tagline: Tevill is a DEX with NFT rewards for successful transactions
description: Defi meets NFT's. Tevill is a decentralized exchange built on top of Moralis and 1inch on the Polygon Mainnet with NFT rewards using NFTPort for successful transaction. Built with the goal of token swap being as cheap as possible hence Polygon for low fees with fees as low as a fraction of cent
how_its_made: The project uses Moralis, Polygon, 1inch plugin, web3.storage, NFTPort, Sia.  Moralis- Utilizing Moralis servers and plugin's did all the heavy lifting and made the development a breeze. Polygon-Project on the mainnet, web3.storage- stores metadata and files for current NFT and future NFT's, NFTPort- Simple,free and instant NFT minting, Sia-front-end hosting
